product_metadata.title: Food Meat Thermometer-Digital Instant Read Ultra Fast Cooking Thermometer with Long Folding Probe, Backlight and Magnet for Food Cooking, BBQ, Milk, Coffee, and Oil Deep Frying
features: 🧀【Instant Read and Accurate】-Food thermometer only takes 2-3 seconds to measure the speed of food, with accurate display and clearer readings. Press the ℉/℃ button to switch the temperature between Centigrade and Fahrenheit and accurate to +/-1 degrees with a wide range of -58℉-572℉（-50°C~300°C）.

🥪【Temperature alarm setting】-There're five settings, including lamb, beef, turkey, chicken and other temperature setting options of our food thermometer. Large instant thermometer dial with bright blue backlight means you can always read the temperature, whether you are grilling in the dark or baking in your kitchen.

🍳【Dual Probe Thermometer】-Different from the traditional food thermometer probe design, our oven thermometer uses a dual probe design. You can use the probe in the oven, the wire is sturdy and allows oven door to close completely.

🥓【Large Screen & Magnetic】Digital instant read meat thermometer with foldable probe design folds away easily and locks into base for portability. Meat food thermometer digital with magnetic back and hook allows for convenient storage
🧆【Safe & Easy to Use】-This cooking thermometer probe is made of food grade 304 stainless steel, the hand shank shell is made of eco-friendly ABS. There is no longer a danger of hot hands!
description: Oven Meat Safe Instant Read 2 in 1 Dual Probe Food Thermometer Digital with Alarm Function for Cooking BBQ Smoking Grilling Kitchen
